quality_policy.rule: No technique is included to meet a numeric quota.
quality_policy.inclusion: Each record must have a recognized technical source and/or elite competition/direct-instruction validation, a current rules/safety review, and a distinct technical purpose.
quality_policy.elite_variants: C records are verified and effective but style-dependent; they are not universal defaults.
quality_policy.reference_only: D records, if present, are reference-only and excluded from normal progression.

level_definitions.beginner: Foundational actions with low prerequisite burden; balance, safety and repeatable mechanics come first.
level_definitions.intermediate: Established fundamentals plus timing, chaining, positional awareness or reaction-based execution.
level_definitions.advanced: Higher coordination, reaction dependence, positional risk, rules complexity, specialist execution or elite-system variation.

sources.name: England Boxing — Level 1 Coaching Handbook
sources.use: Primary mechanics for stance, guard, footwork, punches and basic defence.

sources.name: Teddy Atlas — The Fundamentals of Boxing
sources.use: Elite coaching validation for distance, defence, movement and counters.

sources.name: Teddy Atlas — Footwork: Boxing's Transit System
sources.use: Elite footwork, angle creation, ring cutting and trap-setting.

sources.name: England Boxing — Level 2 Coaching Handbook
sources.use: Combination work, tactical development and advanced coaching.

sources.name: Teddy Atlas — Intelligence: The Art of Counter Punching
sources.use: Counter-punching systems, defensive-to-offensive transitions, timing and traps.

sources.name: Teddy Atlas — The Peekaboo Style of Boxing
sources.use: Pressure entries, side-to-side movement, combination punching and safe pocket exits; variant-only validation.

sources.name: Mike Tyson — Peekaboo fundamentals excerpt
sources.use: Elite-method validation for protected pressure entry; stored only as a variant, not universal doctrine.
